title: S&P DJI March 2027 quarterly rebalance — constituent changes announced and pro-forma files released after the close
source: EST: date derived by applying the owner's own announcement convention to the 2027 calendar. S&P DJI publishes each quarter's rebalance constituent changes after the close on the FIRST FRIDAY of the rebalance month, two Fridays before the third-Friday implementation. The convention holds in 7 of 7 releases this event family has read, each checked mechanically against its own month's Friday list on 2026-09-09: 2024-12-06, 2025-03-07, 2025-09-05, 2025-12-05, 2026-03-06, 2026-06-05 and 2026-09-04 are all the first Friday of their month. TWO OF THE SEVEN WERE FETCHED DIRECT BY THE PROPOSING SESSION from S&P DJI's own newsroom (HTTP 200 each) and are the March instances: press.spglobal.com/2025-03-07-DoorDash,-TKO-Group-Holdings,-Williams-Sonoma-and-Expand-Energy-Set-to-Join-S-P-500-... (92,611 bytes) and press.spglobal.com/2026-03-06-Vertiv-Holdings,-Lumentum-Holdings,-Coherent,-and-EchoStar-Set-to-Join-S-P-500-... (94,408 bytes). The other five are the sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21 and sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-12-20 ledgers' own citations, inherited as dates rather than re-fetched — stated because it is the weaker half of the evidence. The first Friday of March 2027 is 2027-03-05 (weekday arithmetic computed mechanically; March 2027's Fridays are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th). Filed estimate on three counts: the convention is an induction over seven instances rather than a methodology clause (spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/methodologies/methodology-sp-us-indices.pdf returned HTTP 403 to the proposing runner on 2026-09-09, so no announcement-schedule clause was read from the methodology itself and nothing was silently substituted), the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published schedule, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Proposed by sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-03-22 initial research, 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-03-22 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09) and filed as a GAP in a series this calendar already tracks for two other quarters — sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-09-04 and sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-12-04 — with no March 2027 equivalent. This is the ANNOUNCEMENT, not the flow: the share, float and membership changes are effective prior to the open of 2027-03-22 and are implemented at the 2027-03-19 close, the same closing auction as the opex-2027-03-19 quarterly expiration, and this release is when passive managers first see what they must trade there. So it is the earliest dated read on how large that market-on-close imbalance will be, and it is the session where the proposer's sibling measured the effect actually landing: the September 2026 lane found 28 of 32 named companies moving in the direction their index action predicts on the announcement session (sign p=0.002%), with the S&P SmallCap 600 cohort perfect at 12 of 12, while the EFFECTIVE open is an index-level null. Low impact and market-structure only: it changes execution timing on high-open-interest names, never direction, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4/G1) is opex- or rebalance-keyed — re-grepped by the proposing session for `rebalanc|index effect|reconstitut|deletion|witching|closing auction`, zero hits. The date is the sole thing this entry asserts and it carries its own forward test in the proposer's fragment (FT-sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-03-22-3, score by 2027-03-12): a shift to an adjacent business day scores a pass, a different WEEK scores a kill and re-dates this file. ONE SIBLING MILESTONE WAS DELIBERATELY DECLINED by the same sweep and is recorded so a later lane does not re-litigate it: a capped-pro-forma entry for 2027-03-12 is derivable (the September 2026 quarter carries sp-rebalance-proforma-capped-2026-09-11 on the second Friday), but 2027-03-12 already carries sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-03-12, and the December sibling's precedent is not to file a second market-structure entry onto a session this calendar already tracks. Symbols deliberately EMPTY: the March 2027 roster does not exist until this release publishes. Kind 'sector' matches the sibling market-structure entries; EventKind has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane. Filed estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
